updates.tweet_text: Trading is never perfect. On every *winning* trade I either 1) Exit most size too early 2) Exit too late. You won't consistently top & bottom tick moves. Impossible. Goal is to be green & take pieces out follow a consistent trade management process trade after trade, not perfect
updates.notes: Pure trading philosophy commentary. No prices mentioned, no actionable levels named.
